code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/rational.rs: RationalMatrix checks rectangular shape, serializes exact canonical strings and validates wire entries via core_kernel parsing. Direct from_rows accepts Exact values without independently rejecting raw zero denominators; bounds/resources are not capped here, and public get uses indexing. Determinant clears denominators and delegates Bareiss, SPD delegates exact LDLT, rank delegates exact row reduction; characteristic polynomial implements rational Faddeev-LeVerrier. L1 certificate replay delegates core_functional exact primal/dual checking and keeps a private output-only certificate without Deserialize. Standard LP verifies nonnegative primal/dual vectors, inequalities, dimensions and exact objective equality; weak duality suffices for optimality although documentation invokes strong duality. Its public result fields do not themselves retain instance binding. Tests cover feasible/gapped/infeasible cases, quotient witnesses, exact wire negatives, and source-token checks, but not the newly inspected characteristic/SPD/rank methods or raw-denominator/resource extremes.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/cochain.rs: Constructs oriented graph incidence with correct self-loop cancellation and accumulates repeated face coefficients; dense storage preflight checks products/count limits. General public/deserializable complexes are revalidated through ExactCochainComplexQ at evaluation, then exact core_functional Gamma2 and primal/dual Phi1 determine exact, closed nonexact or nonclosed cases. Protected answers are equality checks on supplied maps; optional source custody verifies supplied bytes against supplied hashes but does not derive the graph from those bytes. Optional budget spends one evaluation allowance before dimension/chain checks, not arithmetic cost; no context permits an unbound carrier. Public deserializable CochainDisposition can carry unchecked labels when constructed outside evaluate. Graph face coefficients are accumulated before the external zero-denominator gate, a raw-rational boundary worth guarding. Tests exercise triangle dispositions/refusals, self/parallel edges, repeated/cancelled faces, overflow preflight, source mismatch and zero budget. No natural-language encoding adequacy or universal semantic preservation is established.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/f2.rs: Dense Boolean exact arithmetic implements RREF with separate pivot-row advancement, rank, solve, kernel basis and chain-law-first gauge trichotomy with concrete syndrome, preimage or separating functional. Public matrices hide data and wire conversion uses new, but rows*cols is unchecked in new/zeros and allocations (F023). Direct-source probes reproduce constructor and JSON panic under checked overflow and malformed matrix acceptance otherwise without allocating large storage. Exhaustive matrices of dimensions0..3 pass5054 solve/rank/kernel cases and all 2x2 gauge boards/cochains pass1024 witness checks per build mode. Existing tests cover triangle cases, gauge invariance and ordinary dimension mismatches. Verdict enums remain public/deserializable declarations unless produced/rechecked against the board; finite algebra does not establish physical gauge interpretation.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/modular.rs: Implements exact i128 Euclidean residue for positive modulus with documented panic outside that domain. The checked wrapper refuses nonpositive modulus and checks range plus reconstruction with checked subtraction/division/multiplication. Consequently it can conservatively refuse valid extreme negative inputs when lhs-residue underflows, even though rem_euclid has a value. CheckedResidue has no public value accessor in this module. Tests cover -17 mod5 and zero-modulus refusal/panic plus exactly reconstructed capacity boilerplate. No modular group law beyond this operation is checked.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/operand.rs: Selection filters caller-declared Promoted status, actual prompt-text bytes<=1600, declared tokens<=400, exact byte-count equality and optional target colour, then takes at most3/1200 declared tokens. Promotion status/evidence hash/authority string are public unverified metadata; token estimate is not recomputed. Rendering independently accepts arbitrary operand references, and title/ID overhead is outside the size budget. The only local test fabricates Ok/Err tags and never calls selection, so the documented mutation-kill gate is not demonstrated here. This is bounded selection relative to declared estimates, not actual model-token or authority certification.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/curriculum.rs: Builds one deterministic connected path-plus-chords graph for each positive target b1 and stores the chords as a reference; the seed argument is unused. Arithmetic and allocation have no resource ceiling and extreme target arithmetic can overflow. Public canonical digest sorts degree and weight multisets, providing relabelling invariance but not graph canonicalization: direct-source K3,3/prism counterexample shares digest despite different triangle counts (F024). Checker fixity compares two supplied strings without checking checker bytes or reference-answer computation. Local test merely fabricates Ok/Err tags, so claims of certified instances/self-play diversity or mutation adequacy are unsupported by this file.
